question:
給定課本版本的 COUNTING_SORT 演算法。
COUNTING_SORT(A, B, k)
1  for i <- 1 to k
2    do C[i] <- 0
3  for j <- 1 to length[A]
4    do C[A[j]] <- C[A[j]] + 1
5  > C[i] now contains the number of elements equal to i
6  for i <- 2 to k
7    do C[i] <- C[i] + C[i-1]
8  > C[i] now contains the number of elements less than or equal to i
9  for j <- length[A] downto 1
10   do B[C[A[j]]] <- A[j]
11      C[A[j]] <- C[A[j]] - 1
題目：A 陣列的內容為 2, 5, 3, 0, 2, 3, 0, 5, 1, 2, 1, 3, 2, 0, 4。
填空：
(1) 執行完後 B 陣列的內容為何（格式範例：2,5,3,0,2,3,0,3）
(2) C 陣列的內容為何（格式範例：2,5,3,0,2,3,0,3）

question:
給定課本版本的 BUCKET_SORT 演算法。
BUCKET_SORT(A)
1  n <- length[A]
2  for i <- 1 to n
3    do insert A[i] into list B[floor(n * A[i])]
4  for i <- 0 to n-1
5    do sort list B[i] with insertion sort
6  concatenate B[0], B[1], ..., B[n-1] together in order
題目：A 陣列的內容為 0.78, 0.17, 0.39, 0.26, 0.72, 0.94, 0.21, 0.12, 0.23, 0.68。
